svg.title: Your Robot's Sixth Sense
svg.desc: A simplified, small-size Zumo illustration uses left, front, and right proximity detectors. A close hand gives a front reading of 6, a nearby wall gives a left reading of 2, and open space gives a right reading of 0. A warning explains that the readings are echoes, not distances. All labels and instructional overlays remain live SVG text and vectors.
svg.text: One detector looks ahead. Two look out of the sides. Nothing here is visible to your eyes.
A READING IS AN ECHO, NOT A DISTANCE
Higher is closer — but only for the same object. A big white box far away can out-echo a small black cup up close.
Same number, different truth. That is Section 3.5.
